What is Orgullo, Pasión, y Gloria?

Orgullo, Pasión, y Gloria: Tres Noches en la Ciudad de México (Portuguese: Orgulho, Paixão e Glória: Três Noites na Cidade do México), (English: Pride, Passion and Glory: Three Nights in Mexico City) was recorded at Foro Sol, Mexico City, Mexico on June 4, 6 and 7, 2009 during the World Magnetic Tour. It was supposed to be released in Latin America only, but it is also available in Northern Europe. The record was released in four formats:

It also features interviews with the band members and all the credits in Spanish (and Portuguese for Brazil).

On September 22, 2010, the deluxe version was released in Japan containing the two DVDs and two SHM-CDs.
